contracts.declared_mechanism: deepagents create_deep_agent human-in-the-loop registration: tools=[request_confirmation, read_file] with interrupt_on={"request_confirmation": True} (agent.py:22,28). request_confirmation is an annotation-only @tool whose docstring declares it 'запрашивает подтверждение у пользователя перед отправкой задания' and whose comments state that interruption and response handling are performed by the framework (tools.py:112-117).
